input.prompt:

1. The overall src/ directory structure (list all files/directories)
2. The content of src/hooks/useTasks.ts

input.content:
feat: add in-app task CRUD UI — new task modal, inline status/priority edit, delete

- NewTaskForm modal collects title, status, priority, project, dueDate and POSTs to /api/tasks; shows inline error on failure
- AssignmentsList gains inline <select> controls for status and priority per row, a hover-revealed delete button, and an optional "+ New" button in the card header
- Dashboard wires onStatusChange/onPriorityChange/onDelete handlers (PATCH/DELETE /api/tasks/:id) and calls refresh() after each mutation so StatCards and GapAnalysis recompute live
- AssignmentsList tests updated to pass the new required callbacks; three new test cases cover status selects, delete buttons, and the New button

input.resolutionDetail: Created NewTaskForm modal, updated AssignmentsList with inline status/priority selects and delete button, wired Dashboard mutation handlers with refresh()
